mu_name_from: MuMain's _enum.h: MONSTER_HELL_HOUND = 5, drawn out of the Hound's own model (MONSTER_MODEL_HOUND, Monster02.bmd): `case MONSTER_HOUND: case MONSTER_HELL_HOUND: OpenMonsterModel(MONSTER_MODEL_HOUND)` (ZzzCharacter.cpp:14120-14140). The client's name is 헬하운드. OpenMU's Version075 Dungeon.cs:624-651 names number 5 'Hell Hound' at level 38 with 1400 health, 125-130 damage, 55 defense, MoveRange 3, AttackRange 1, ViewRange 4, AttackDelay 1200, respawn 10 s, no AttackSkill, resistance F3. Fourteen spots, all in Dungeon 2.
mesh_from: Monster02 a second time, as the Elite Bull Fighter is Monster01 a second time: every difference is a field CreateMonster sets beside the one loaded model, so this entry points at Hound01's glb and builds nothing of its own. See EliteBullFighter01's mesh_from.
monster_from: The MONSTER_HELL_HOUND branch: `c->Object.HiddenMesh = 1; c->Weapon[0].Type = MODEL_FALCHION; c->Weapon[1].Type = MODEL_PLATE_SHIELD; c->Object.Scale = 1.1f; c->Level = 1;`. Level 1 draws nothing on the Hound: no case in MoveCharacterVisual or RenderCharacter reads it for MODEL_HOUND.
hidden_mesh_from: `c->Object.HiddenMesh = 1`, where the plain Hound hides mesh 0: the two variants each hide the other's head. Mesh 0 is hound_head01, the brass-trimmed helm over a dark mail hood, which Hound01's build ships as the part called `hidden` (the plain Hound puts it away); mesh 1 is hound_head02, the bare snarling head, which ships as `fur`. So the Hell Hound names its own part, `hidden_part: fur`, and the cook cuts it a mesh of its own (Hound01~fur) that drops the bare head and keeps the helm. Until this line it was cooked on the plain Hound's rule and wore the bare fur head with its helm dropped -- lighter than MU's (the user: 'i think hell hound was darker in MuMain').
hands_from: MODEL_FALCHION is Item/Sword08.bmd and MODEL_PLATE_SHIELD Item/Shield10.bmd, both cooked. The bones are the model's: `case MODEL_HOUND: c->Weapon[0].LinkBone = 19; c->Weapon[1].LinkBone = 14` (ZzzCharacter.cpp:12056-12058) -- 19 is Bone_left and 14 bone_right, the artist's names the wrong way round again, as the plain Hound's note says.
sounds_from: The Hound's model and so the Hound's five: SetMonsterSound is per model, not per breed. Wired as hellhound_*, the same files as hound_*.
